issue: धरो मात अवतार — Braj धरो read as past (धरा, 'you took incarnation'), after भुवन विराजी; it could be an imperative ('take incarnation, Mother').
our reading: Mother, you took incarnation for the good of your devotees.
alternatives: Mother, take incarnation for the good of your devotees

issue: बल को भोग स्वांस दिन राती कंधे से विनय सुनाऊँ — कंधे से ('from the shoulders') is obscure; read as 'with bowed shoulders'. स्वांस दिन राती read as a further offering (my every breath, day and night), after the stanza's pattern of offerings.
our reading: I offer my strength as food, and my every breath day and night, and with bowed shoulders I tell you my prayer.
alternatives: कंठ से ('from my throat', i.e. singing) as the original; स्वांस दिन राती as 'with every breath, day and night, I tell you my prayer'

issue: कर्ण को टीका — 'a ṭīkā of the ear' is obscure; read in the stanza's pattern (garland of austerity, banner of meditation) as 'a ṭīkā of the listening ear'.
our reading: a ṭīkā of the listening ear
alternatives: कर्म को टीका ('a ṭīkā of good deeds') as the original
